Resist Magic (cost 8/40, 0 upkeep) – research cost decreases from 320 to 280. Psionic Blast (cost 20/-) – attack strength change from 18 at 30% hit chance to 11 at 60% hit chance and research cost decreases from 380 to 360. Blur (costs 24/-) – trade value decreases from 19 to 16 but now cost of the spell is decreased from 25 to 24 and has stronger synergy with invisibility (top up damage reduction change from 10% to 20%) Aura of Majesty (cost -/200, 12 upkeep) – now common-tier but player should double-check before investing on a 12 upkeep spell early on. This was the most appropriate spell to move to common based on the focus magic change.
PDF page 72 Sorcery Uncommon Spells Focus Magic (cost 16/80, 2 upkeep) – now uncommon-tier due to later access to mage-type units and to increase difficulty in successfully applying overpowered combos with other realms. The unit enchantment also felt too advanced and complex to be a common spell, but relative to other changes in this mod, this spell was too limited in use early in the game (casting it on nagas is not as good as it appears). Stoning (and death) touch also no longer can apply in ranged attacks. This eliminates 'focus magic cockatrices' combo. You cannot 'touch' with ranged attacks, makes 0 logical sense. The spell get compensated by new ability to cast in combat, +1 maximum spell charge, and increase of trade value from 12 to 20. Confusion (cost 16/-) – the spell is moving up from common to uncommon with lower casting cost (from 18 to 16) and higher save penalty (from -2 to -3) with research cost increases from 320 to 700. Aether Binding (cost -/300, 15 upkeep) – Cost decreased but the dispelling strength effect is halved. It is now a mostly economical spell. The doubled dispel power was moved to the new Power Link. Flight (cost 22/110, 2 upkeep) – the spell is the same except for research cost is lower from 1280 to 1000. NEW: Mariner Mastery (cost -/250, 8 upkeep) – Uncommon Global that permanently grants +2 move to all sailing units and mechanical flying ships (when recruited) and floating island and +1 to water walking units during combat as long as spell is active, granting sorcery a naval advantage over other realms Water Elemental Coatl (cost -/150, 3 upkeep) – replaces water elemental (Which was moved to nature as combat summon replacing Construct Catapult ). This mobile, flying unit with low caster points is meant to be tactical flying cavalry but not very good in stats alone thus not intended to be used as a brute force unit. Caster ability helps it self-cast Guardian Wind or Resist Magic or AEether sparks depending on circumstance. Spell Lock (cost -/100, 1 upkeep) – the spell is the same as in Caster of Magic for Windows Philosopher’s Stone Magic Perimeter (cost -/75, 1 upkeep) – Although it still give magic weapon to newly trained unit, it does not give access to ore utilization. Note: counter magic has also been weakened to strength 60 (from 70). Counter Magic (cost 40/-) – Cheaper casting cost of 40 (instead of 50) and lower research cost to 1600 (from 2140) but weaker with starting counter strength of 60 (instead of 70). Phantom Beast (cost 35/-, 2 upkeep) – research cost increases to 1800 (from 1600). Dispelling Wave (cost 25+/-) – research cost increases to 2000 (from 1920). NEW: Magocracy (cost -/400, 20 upkeep) – Uncommon Global. All caster cities gain gold from magic markets and wizard guilds equivalent to their power income (base 4 and 12, respectively). Sorcery has many tools to help you progress as a wizard and this has the capacity of increasing your gold income by triple digits.
PDF page 73 Sorcery Rare Spells Disillusionise (cost -/50+) – trade value reduced to 24 (from 28) and research cost decreases to 2400 (from 4000) NEW: Aether Sink (cost -/100, 2 upkeep) – Rare city curse, Cuts non-religious power (minimum=5) and skill income from city in half, making you even stronger as a wizard relative to opponents. Flying Fortress (cost -/200, 3 upkeep) – research cost increases to 2800 (from 2400) Spell Blast (cost -/50) – research cost decreases to 3000 (from 5600) Stasis (cost 35/175) – the spell get significantly more expensive but coming with a impressively stronger -7 resistance modifier. Invisibility (cost 30/150, 6 upkeep) – research cost is decreased to 3500 (from 3600) and has stronger internal synergy with Blur (damage reduction top up increases from 10% to 20%). NEW: Kraken (cost -/310, 8 upkeep) – Rare summon. A swimming creature with high melee and defense stats. Kraken specializes at hunting down transport ships: while at sea it gains stealth and in battles situated at sea (+3 move, fire immunity, invisible, +10% to defend), giving Sorcery realm further naval advantages. Reinforce Magic (cost -/500, 25 upkeep) – trade value increases to 34 (from 33) Banish (cost 40/-) – get more powerful with -5 resistance modifier and higher trade value (from 25 to 26). Mind Storm (cost 35/-) – research cost reduces to 4000 (from 4800) NEW: Sea Serpent (cost 75/-, 15 upkeep) – rare combat summons. Sea Serpent is a rare level creature with strengtth as strong as very rare level fantastic creature but could only be summoned on water tile. Apart from usage for naval combat, it might be useful in defending some city with Fortification or Baray. Air Elemental (cost 50/-, 5 upkeep) – research cost reduces to 4300 (from 4400) NEW: Cloud Giant (cost -/330, 9 upkeep) – replaces storm giant. This is a different version that attacks with illusion, flies, and has 'lucky' trait. Its stats were significantly lower to balance out these enhancements, resulting in a summon of comparable usefulness to storm giant, just modified to fit the nature of 'sorcery'. Wind Walking (cost -/200, 7 upkeep) – ability of Wind Walking enchanment is now called “High Wind Walking” to separate from version without overland movement bonus. Research cost decreases to 4900 (from 5200) NEW: Temporal Twist (cost 40/-) – Rare combat global enchantment – all enemy units lose 1 movement, teleport, first strike, and negate first strike. If the unit is fantastic, it loses an additional movement point. Speed reduces by Temporal Twist would not cause unit speed to go below 0.5. There isn't a counter to first strike/negate first strike in this game and this spell is ideal against summons, something Sorcery is good against. NEW: Aether Surge (cost 60/-) – Rare combat global enchantment. All caster's units in combat gain +10 casting skill, this includes units which originally does not have casting MP. Each turn, current MP would have MP replenish at rate 5 MP per turn and spell charge would be recharged every 4 turns until the end of combat. Uranus Blessing (cost -/225, 7 upkeep) – redesigned to grant power equal to city's research income, which can include buildings, town population, enchantments, sorcery procurator. Cost increased to compensate. The overland skill bonus is now granted by various research buildings instead of just amplifier tower. This spell caught a lot of attention for combo potential, but players attempting to maximize combos unintentionally introduce vulnerabilities. If you manage to pull this off with good synergies, this can win you the game. NEW: Planewalking (cost 30/150, 8 upkeep) – rare unit enchantment, allow unit to plane shift freely on overland map and teleport movement in combat.
PDF page 74 NEW: Storm Giant (cost -/330, 5 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 6 Sorcery spell books.
PDF page 75 Sorcery Very Rare or Higher Spells Creature Binding (cost 55/-) – buffed with -5 resistance modifier. It was underwhelming that sorcery could kill fantastic creatures at -3 in entire world, death could possess a unit at -3 with an uncommon-tier spell, but sorcery with a single target spell has merely 1 more resistance modifier. This comes with higher research cost of 8000 (from 6000) and higher trade value (from 28 to 38) Spell Ward (cost -/150, 1 upkeep) – nothing has changed for this spell but more synergy to feed new Power Link. NEW: Great Unbinding (cost -/1000, 50 upkeep) – powerful very rare global enchantment to replace time ravaging Great Unsummoning. At the beginning of combat all opponent fantastic creatures that participate in combat against the caster have to face Confusion curse with -4 resistance penalty, and even if survive that they still have to deal with significant debuff of -20% To-Hit, -20% To-Defend, and -2 Resistance for the rest of combat. Haste (cost 50/200, 8 upkeep) – now castable overland with 200 cost and 8 upkeep. Overland movement not impacted, only combat movement. This spell effectively doubles your attack strength while granting a unit so much mobility that almost matches teleport. If you can afford the cost, you can save combat turns by casting and maintaining this spell outside of battle. Djinn (cost -/395, 10 upkeep) – Now comes with caster 40, helping it cast the stronger banish spell, temporal twist and not be behind efreet's caster capabilities. Magic Immunity (cost 45/180, 10 upkeep) – higher casting cost prevents Djinn from self-casting (unless buffed with focus magic) Wind Mastery (cost -/900, 30 upkeep) – the same as before with minor tweak in AI behavior. Sky Drake (cost -/500, 15 upkeep) – gains mountaineer for sake of synergy with tactician retort, research cost increased to 16000 (from 15000). Spell Binding (cost -/1200) – research cost decreases to 18000 (from 22000) Mass Invisibility (cost 80/-) – the same as in Caster of Magic for Windows except for now synergy with Blur is stronger (damage reduction top up increases to 20% from formerly 10%) NEW: Power Link (cost -/1200, 50 upkeep) – Power Link has been completely changed, including spell image. It now • grants 10 power per city enchantment in all your cities • grants 3 overland skill per enemy Amplifying Tower in play • grants full effect of all enemy monuments and linking towers to your combat skill • makes dispel-type spells +100% effective. If combined with Aether Binding, it simulates old game's 'True' dispel spells. • Eliminates non-capital power income penalty Reason: The original spell was too 'mathematical', caused variable power spikes that could heavily impact domination score and the 'win' button, was too overpowered if obtained early or there are too many players, and didn't seem to affect enemy spell decision logic. The new Power Link has more strategic components while still scaling reasonably well with more players. Time Stop (cost -/1500, +50 upkeep per turn, +250 upkeep per city taken during Time Stop,) – apart from lower casting cost but higher upkeep, research cost decreases to 22000 (from 24000), combat during Time Stop changes with all opponent units in combat have to resist at -7 or suffered Stasis, no normal overland damage recovery, and casting skill decay by 3% each turn (capped at not lower than 10%, will recovered once Time Stop is no longer maintained) while cast cost of spell increases by 1% for each spell cast during Time Stop. So now Time Stop becomes more combat-oriented and reduced number of things that could be done if maintaining the spell for too long and finishing Spell of Mastery during Time Stop is nigh impossible.
PDF page 76 NEW: Cloud Elephant (cost -/550, 15 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 8 Sorcery spell books. NEW: AEther Mastery (reform, effect taken upon researched) – Increases enchantment dispel resistance, reduces casting cost of the spells, and buff creature of the Sorcery realm under wizard control. This reform is only available to Specialist retort holder with Sorcery as primary realm. Once this spell appears on research page, it will exclude chance to get mastery of other realm. NEW: Lesser AEther Lord (cost -/777, 20 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 10 Sorcery spell books. NEW: Great AEther Lord (cost -/999, 30 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 12 Sorcery spell books. NEW: Power of Sorcery (cost 99/-) – This spell could only be learned by Enchanter wizard who already have access to Resist Magic, Guardian Wind, Flight, Focus Magic, Planewalking, Invisibility, Haste, and Magic Immunity. This spell would allow the Enchanter to cast all above unit enchantment all at once on single target! NEW: Mystery of Sorcery (cost 150/-) – This spell could only be learned by Runemaster wizard who already have access to Blur, Counter Magic, Aether Surge, Temporal Twist, and Mass Invisibility. This spell would allow the Runemaster to cast all above combat enchantment all at once!
PDF page 77 Chaos: Chaos realm specializes in blitzkrieg tactics with mobile units that excel in offense and combat spells that quicken the pace of combat for earlier resolution. Combat spells are prominent and often focus on damaging individual units and armies. Later in game, chaos is also aggressive against cities as well as terrain, sabotaging enemy economically on a global scale with caster wizard gaining benefits from such effects at the same time. New spells further establish these realm characteristics. Removed Chaos Spells Flame Blade (becomes unit ability) – grants +3 melee, +2 physical range/thrown, and +1 fire breath (granting ability to hit flyers). This ability could nolonger able to be countered by anything but Chaos Ward. This ability can only be cast by dwarf combat engineers. Berserk (becomes unit ability) – completely new spell and not relate to original’s Berserk. Target unit gains +15% To-Hit and +1 combat Movement but suffers -10% To-Defend. Could only be casted by Troll Medicinemans. Fate Mastery → Dance of Death . The spell felt misplaced in chaos realm and not worth keeping just to introduce a chaos+death combo. The spell is move to Death realm at rare tier. Warp Lightning → Lightning Rage (cost 30/-) – Warp Lightning is renamed to Lightning Rage and only available to the Warlock hero. Chaos Common Spells Hell Hounds (cost -/54, 1 upkeep) – Boosted to have 5 movement and slightly higher cost (from 40 to 48), it acts relatively similar to a barbarian cavalry unit – great for exploration and to reach the other side of the battlefield in 2 moves. This fits the theme of chaos being an aggressive magic realm and speed is an element that adds to its aggressive nature. The cost effectiveness brings back the original MoM starting game chaos hell hound spam strategies. Animate Ammo (cost 5/-) – Research cost decreases to 280 (from 320). Corruption (cost -/30) – Reduced cost by 10 given more options for units with purify ability and faster roads to move them where needed. Research cost also decreases to 240 (from 260). Fire Bolt (cost 9/-) – Attack strength of Fire Bolt reduces from 24 to 12 but hit chance is doubled (from 30% to 60%). Spell’s research cost is reduced to 280 (from 320). The spell’s cost get lowered (from 10 to 9) to ensure chaos is best realm at direct damage. Wall of Fire (cost 30/60, 1 upkeep) – Instead of 10-strength to all figures, it is 12-strength (60% hit chance) but not on all figure. It also grants +1 attack to all defending normal unit non-magic attacks, similar to original game's Metal Fires. Wall of fire now costs 30 to cast while in combat (from 20), has 1 upkeep (from previously 0), reduced in trade value, and its research cost is reduced to 280 (from 320). Warp Creature (cost 10/-) – spell research cost is reduced to 320 (from 380) but trade value is increased as the spell get upgrade to be cursed by 3 types of warp creature effects at once once caster casted Doom Mastery. Shatter – Spell move to rare tier to allow room for the similar but more interesting 'Rust' NEW Rust (cost 7/-) – common-tier combat unit curse. Resistance roll of -5 penalty. If successful: • Unit with magic weapons or orihalcon lose those bonuses permanently , have regular weapons • Unit loses 3 of its physical attack • All thrown attack is eliminated until end of combat • Large shield, if present, is eliminated until end of combat.
PDF page 78 Rust is the only spell in the game that invalidates magic weapons altogether – the strategies around weapon immunity bring significant synergy with death. Flame Blade Fiery Fury (cost 10/50, 1 upkeep) – Now also grants +2 to all non-magic, non-elemental ranged attack types, and thrown, not just some ranged attack types. Also, if cast on a fantastic creature, it turns that creature into chaos (thus benefiting from chaos global effects) and gives first strike. Research cost of the spell is cheaper than Flame Blade (360 compared to Flame Blade’s 480) and has a bit more trade value. NEW Blaze of Glory (cost 20/-) – Combat only unit enchantment – shifts armor points to melee, ranged points also to melee, grants armor piercing, but enchanted unit loses first strike (if present). This is similar in spirit to the original game's berserk, but chaos tends to be the most 'reckless' realm, thus fitting here. It is one of the common-tier combat spells that is powerful throughout game (just like web) Breakthrough (cost 9/-) – This new combat enchantment is made by Seravy as replacement of the most useless spell to be casted by wizard in game, Disrupt. The spell has multiple effect which is basically enchant melee attack, especially to combat summon and Non-Corporeal units, and grant all units Wall Crashing ability.
PDF page 79 Chaos Uncommon Spells Gargoyles (cost -/100, 1 upkeep) – The creature is more or less the same with research cost increases to 500 (from previously 420) and a little bit lower trade value. Chaos Channels (cost -/50, 0 upkeep) – The spell is increased in trade value and research cost also increased to 700 (from 640). Fire breath version is now also stack with unit original fire breath. If caster has Doom Mastery, this spell will grants all three effects instead of just one. Fire Elemental (cost 24/-, 2 upkeep) – Moved to uncommon, given immolation, higher hp, and changed its attack pattern to be entirely 'fire breath' oriented. The 'weapon immunity' early game design is now exclusive to death realm, while chaos is allowed to excel at the start with combat spells. Immolation (cost 13/65, 2 upkeep) – Now costs 13/65 (from 12/60) due to considered as superior than Fireball, but trade value is decreased to 9 (from 10) and research cost is reduced to 1000 (from 1280) as opportunity to use the spell is lower. Fire Giant (cost -/110, 3 upkeep) – Fireball spell removed, added +1 range and +1 ammo, +1 armor, +2hp, and large shield. Research cost is reduced to 1100 (from 1280) but trade value of the spell is increased to 20 (from 17). Raise Volcano (cost -/50) – The spell is more or less the same but volcano is now more useful terrain with recent combo with Chaos’ Blessing (+3 power) and Ice Age (+1 Max Population) as well as there are more use of mineral that caster could get from spawning volcano. Fireball (cost 19/-) – Now strength is increased to 14 (from 12) but with cost increase. Needed more strength to justify its research cost that is also increased to 1280 (from 960). Lightning Bolt (cost 24/-) – Now costs is decreased to 24 (from previously 25) so it could be accessed by ultra elite caster 20 units. Attack strength is changed to strength 18 at 60% To-Hit (from previously strength 36 at 30% To-Hit) to make damage more consistent and reliable. Research cost is also decreased to 1400 (from 1600). NEW: Insulation (cost 16/80, 2 upkeep) – New uncommon unit enchantment that provides fire immunity, cold immunity, and lightning resistance. Situationally useful with an obvious combo with Inner Power, but fairly expensive and situational otherwise. NEW: Corrosive Blast (cost 29/-) – A new uncommon damage dealer that ignores even magic immunity and is irrecoverable. This is a very niche spell when you face the need to damage a sky drake or magic immune hero via spells or really need to deal irrecoverable damage. Otherwise, stick to lightning bolt for better cost effectiveness. Chimeras (cost -/180, 4 upkeep) – Now moves 4 and is mountaineer, feels more aggressive and threatening as a result and will likely be your staple summoning unit halfway through the game. Research cost is also decreased a bit to 2000 (from 2140). Blazing March (cost 45/-) – Moved from rare to uncommon so that chaos can get a global combat effect like prayer and black prayer around the same time as those other 2 realms. The spell now also boosts thrown. Research cost is also reduced to 2200 to make it consistent with being Uncommon spell.
PDF page 80 Chaos Rare Spells Mystic Surge (cost 25/-) – Moved to rare from previously uncommon, removes the buggy 'healing immunity', and a bit more likely to grant positive effects, thus more powerful than in Caster of Magic. Research cost is increased to 2400 (from previously 1280) to be consistent with its current status as rare spell. Fire Storm (cost -/180) – Its attack strength is increased to 14 (from previously 12) and research cost is decreased to 2600 (from 2800) but trade value is decreased. Chaos Rift (cost -/200, 5 upkeep) – Attack strength from the enchantment reduced to 9 per strike (from previously 11). In addition to current effects, new recruits from cursed city has a 10% chance of permanently receiving 1 random warp creature effect (0 resistance, 1/3 armor, or ½ attack), effect is permanent and could not be dispelled. Chaos Spawn (cost -/303, 8 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 3000 (from previously 3200) but upkeep cost is increased to 8 (from previously 5). NEW: Chaos’ Blessing (cost -/200, 5 upkeep) – Rare level city enchantment that grants chaos channels to recruited units and defending city has Warp Reality cast in combat. It has synergy with Doom Mastery (which has been moved to very rare tier). Chaos’ Blessing also grants power to enchanted cities for each mountain (+1) and volcano (+3) tiles in the vicinity. Chaos’ Blessing might give you an early advantage as not every city is a unit producing center at that point and if defending primarily with chaos units, warp reality gives you a very significant advantage. Inner Power (cost -/600, 20 upkeep) – Now casting costs is increased significantly (from previously 390) and slightly increase of trade value due to obvious combo with insulation. Also grants mountaineer to friendly units in combat. Research cost is decreased to 3500 (from previously 3600). NEW: Warp Lightning (cost 36/-) – Rare level combat spell that replacing old spell with same name that hardcoded could not change. Warp Lightning hits all figures in a target unit with strength 14 lightning damage, providing Chaos wizards and efreets and effective counter to multi-figure units. Magic Vortex (cost 50/-) – I have struggled with idea of remove or replace this spell for very long time but in the end I decide to just reduced its trade value instead. Doom Bolt (cost 45/-) – Research cost is reduced to 4000 (from previously 4800) and trade value is reduced slightly. Doom Bat (cost -/300, 7 upkeep) – Now costs is reduced to 300 (from previously 320) and fiery immolation aura of the original Master of Magic is coming back as well. NEW: Blood and Iron (cost -/600, 25 upkeep) – New rare level global enchantment, bring chaos supremacist war drum to your populance with cities of caster’s home race or integrate to Chaos realm with Chaos’s blessing gain +30% production while other cities that alienated by this suffer +3 Unrest (which could be convert to 6 power by Chaos Embrace below). The same for regular units, regular units of the home race or with chaos channel gains bonus while units that not fit racial criteria would suffer penalty instead. NEW: Shatter (cost 20/-) – Rare level combat curse, Shatter has been revised to target any unit (not just normal units) and with resistance penalty of -5. What makes this spell stand out is casting it with your magisters and other caster units due to its low cost. NEW: Beat of Swiftness (cost 55/-) – Rare level combat enchantment, all friendly units with melee>range gain +3 movement, the rest get +2 movement. As a penalty, friendly units lose 10% of their armor. This spell further enhances Chaos' strength at quick battle resolution and grants yet another offense advantage. Efreet (cost -/333, 9 upkeep) – has caster 39 to prevent it from casting the new shatter twice. Flame Strike (cost 60/-) – Damage scheming changes to strength 16 at 60% To-Hit on all units (from previously strength 32 at 30% To-Hit). Research cost is also decreased to 5200 (from 5600).
PDF page 81 Disintegrate (cost 50/-) – Moved down from very rare to rare tier with research cost of 5500 and reduces trade value as this spell resistance threshold is not that justified to be very rare tier spell. Warp Reality (cost 75/-) – Another spell that move down from very rare in Caster of Magic to rare tier in Warlord. This spell used to be rare tier in original Master of Magic. Lack of doom mastery in rare tier indirectly weakened this spell. NEW: Incinerate (cost 55/-) – Hit target unit with strong fire attack (strength 18 Magical Fire attack at 60% To- Hit + strength 18 Non-Magical Fire attack at 60% To-Hit) and then hit surrounding with non-magical fire attack with half of the strength (18 Non-Magical Fire attack at 60% To-Hit) of at the center. More effective than Flame Strike when hit enemy that cower behind the wall or stay in tight formation. NEW: Fire Drake (cost -/390, 10 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 6 Chaos spell books.
PDF page 82 Chaos Very Rare or Higher Spells Doom Mastery (cost -/666, 18 upkeep) – Moved to very rare (Same as original Master of Magic) – grants all 3 effects if unit recruited in a city with 'chaos blessing' on them, or chaos channels cast on a hero, or new casting attempt of Chaos Channels. Doom Mastery is also boosting Warp Creature spell by trigger all 3 effects instead of just one. The stacking of chaos creature benefits got to be too excessive when considering other chaos spell changes, but you no longer can rely on using such a strategy in every game (unless you pick 10 chaos books) Hydra (cost -/480, 11 upkeep) – The creature gains more characteristic of Greek mythology; thus it now could swim, breath changed to lightning breath, and high poison damage was also given. Unit also has lightning resistance, thus benefits from inner power global enchantment, and can be an excellent offensive creature when paired with the new 'Beat of Swiftness' spell. The research cost is reduced to 8000 (from previously 10000). Chain Lightning (cost 65/-) – Attack power scheme changes to strength 20 at 60% To-Hit (from previously strength 40 at 30% To-Hit), Research cost is decreased to 10000 (from previously 20000) due to this spell is that far more superior than Incineration or Flame Strike to justified status as penultimate spell of research tree. Chaos Surge (cost -/1000, 30 upkeep) – Given Doom Mastery, this spell is comparable to life realm's global spells and even stacks, thus had to be made less accessible with research cost is increased to 12000 (from previously 6000) to keep Chaos from being overpowered in large, crowded games. Apocalypse (cost 65/-) – Research cost is decreased to 14000 (from previously 15000). Great Drake (cost -/500, 15 upkeep) – The Great Drake is also given mountaineer, lightning resistance, immolation, and cause fear for consistency (to match doom drakes). Doomsday (cost -/1000, 20 upkeep) – Although trade value of the spell is decreased slightly due to the spell does not deliver direct benefit toward the caster, the spell is more powerful with the effect of corruption that randomly decay terrain toward less productive land even after corruption has been purified. NEW: Dissolution (cost 80/-) – This new combat spell is a guaranteed 9 armor-piercing irrecoverable damage (equivalent to 30 strength spell) per figure before shields. This spell's extraordinary power almost always wipes out massively enchanted multi-figure units, thus acting as a counter against mega-buffing strategies. Call the Void (cost -/500) – The spell is the same as what it ever was in Caster of Magic for Windows. It might be slightly more powerful than previous version due to corruption’s terrain decay effect. Blazing Eyes →Chaos Embrace (cost -/1300, 80 upkeep) – Blazing Eye is renamed to Chaos Embrace and given a far higher casting cost (from previously 900) and research cost is increased to 20000 (from previously 8000), thus reducing the chance of stacking global effects to chaos units (see chaos surge above). This new spell grants 2 power income for each of rebel population in caster’s cities. At the same time, each of rebel in the city own by other wizards who not cast Chaos Embrace would deal 0.5 Doom damage to garrison of the city. This would make the caster thrive as the world burned. Meteor Storm (cost -/990, 10 upkeep) – Casting cost and trad value are slightly increased. Spell now also has additional effect to give additional hit to the target when ever casting Fire Bolt, Fireball, or Fire Storm with Magical Fire attack strength 75% of the original preceeding attack. Armageddon (cost -/1250, 40 upkeep) – Now is considered the highest Chaos spell by research cost, but it is slightly weaker than in Caster of Magic due to AI is more eager to disjunct it and damage to relationship with other wizards is much more severe. NEW: Chaos Mastery (reform, effect taken upon researched) – Increases enchantment dispel resistance, reduces casting cost of the spells, and buff creature of the Chaos realm under wizard control. This reform is only available to Specialist retort holder with Chaos as primary realm. Once this spell appears on research page, it will exclude chance to get mastery of other realm. NEW: Lesser Chaos Lord (cost -/777, 20 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 10 Chaos spell books.
PDF page 83 NEW: Great Chaos Lord (cost -/999, 30 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 12 Chaos spell books. NEW: Power of Chaos (cost 66/-) – This spell could only be learned by Enchanter wizard who already have access to Fiery Fury, Immolation, Insulation, and Chaos Channels. This spell would allow the Enchanter to cast all above unit enchantment all at once on single target! NEW: Conduit of Chaos (cost 150/-) – This spell could only be learned by Runemaster wizard who already have access to Breakthrough, Blazing March, Beat of Swiftness, and Warp Reality. This spell would allow the Runemaster to cast all above combat enchantment all at once!
PDF page 84 Life: Life realm specializes in stacking enchantments on your recruitable units to a level where they can easily defeat more advanced foes or defeat entire armies single-handed unscathed. Careful management of unit enchantments on a turn-by-turn basis rewards the most detail-oriented players that can micromanage and keep track of these buffs. Given that the Warlord mod intends to keep normal units relevant throughout all stages of the game, this often translates to unremarkable units being boosted individually to an unmatched level at the beginning or at the end of a game. The importance of these units is addressed by giving life wizards tools to preserve such units or their enchantments. Cities can be viewed similarly in that they can individually perform far beyond other wizards with the help of city enchantment stacking. New spells further establish these realm characteristics. Removed Life Spells Discipline (cost -/-) – No longer researchable, but become Life ability that could be cast by Centurion hero and can now also target heroes. The spell, stacked with herosim, broke the balance of very early game for wizards with life books, resulting in units too strong against lairs and wizards before dispel magic is researched. The enchantment is also grant to unit upon create if Enlightenment is casted (see below) and make the powerful discipline+heroism combos more difficult to achieve at the beginning of the game. Zeal (cost -/-) – used to castable in earlier version but now become Life ability that could be casted by Inquisitors unit and Grand Inquisitor hero, grants first strike and negate first strike to unit until rest of combat. Resurrection (cost -/325) – shifted to arcane rare with 3200 research cost. Life Common Spells Star Fires (cost 12/-) – One of the more efficient direct damage spell in term of cost with no elemental properties but could only damage fantastic creature. Damage scheme is changed to strength 12 at 60% To-Hit (from previously strength 23 at 30% To-Hit). But as it is now much less efficient than Fire Bolt, trade value is decreased. Guardian Spirit (cost -/60, 1 upkeep) – The creature has 1 less armor, but comes with healer, giving it a more supportive role. Trade value of the spell is increased. Holy Weapon (cost 8/40, 0 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased slightly to 240 (from previously 260) and trade value is increased. Bless (cost 7/35, 0 upkeep) – grants 4 resistance (-1 from original) and 7 armor (+2 from original) against chaos/death effects as well as all attack with fire or lightning element. Research cost is decreased to 240 (from previously 320). Healing (cost 15/-) – Research cost is decreased to 280 (from 320). Holy Armor (cost 10/50, 0 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 280 (from 320). Heroism (cost 15/75, 1 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 280 (from 320). NEW: True Light (cost 20/-) – Combat enchantment that grants +1 to all stats for life units, -1 to all stats for death/undead units. True light also weakens illusion attacks by -10% to hit. Warlord mod restores a spell from original Master of Magic, but has more synergy in mod thanks to uncommon spell sanctify. The minor extra effect against illusion helps keep realm balanced after the loss of a major spell. Heavenly Light (cost -/60, 1 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 400 (from previously 440) and trade value is decreased significantly.
PDF page 85 NEW: Spirit of Community (cost -/300, 9 upkeep) – Grants +4 production to all cities and doubles output growth ideal for boosting growth of new towns, but not overly effective on well-developed cities. One of the best spells to pick as 'starting common' for players that like to build up their empire peacefully. However, this spell can also help out when conquering towns that had their production-generating structures destroyed in battle.
PDF page 86 Life Uncommon Spells True Sight (cost 12/60, 1 upkeep) – Casting cost is now lower (from previously 15/75) and also grants +5% to range. Research cost is increased to 500 (from previously 420). Exorcise (cost 18/-) – Casting cost is decreased (from previously 20/-) but research cost is increased to 700 (from previously 640). Sanctify (cost -/60, 2 upkeep) – Spell gains additional effect with units also become life-realm non-fantastic units during combat, helping protect against normal-unit oriented death spells. If cast on a 'cleric' unit (e.g. priest), it turns unit into life fantastic creature during combat, grants +2 spellcasting skill per base resistance of unit. When combine this with Pillar of Faith, some of cleric units would able to cast powerful life spell such as Prayer. Just Cause (cost -/300, 5 upkeep) – The spell moves up tier to Uncommon (from previously Common) spell and unrest reduction changes from -1 to -2. Spell gains additional effect of buffing hero and units within the same stack as hero in combat. Altar of Peace → Altar of Duality (cost -/100, 4 upkeep) – Grants either 12-32 research or 6-16 production depending on how positive (or negative) wizard relations are. The spell was considered too weak as a conditional 0-24 research spell that costs research to learn it and discouraged aggression, which is needed by life to stay competitive. By gaining production when relations are negative, you can build up troops and conquered towns with more ease. Endurance (cost -/60, 2 upkeep) – Trade value is increased. New: Divine Protection (cost 22/110, 1 upkeep) – New rare tier unit enchantment, giving a regular unit Lucky (+10% To-Hit, +10% To-Defend, +1 Resistance) and Death Immunity. This cheaper counterpart of Lionheart is based on Life realm item power of the same name. The spell cost is intentionally allow to be within castable range of elite Magisters or sanctified cleric with base Resistance higher than 10. Stream of Life (cost -/120, 4 upkeep) – Research cost is increased to 1400 (from previously 1280). Unicorn (cost -/190, 4 upkeep) – The creature is now coming with Purify, helping clean corrupted land. Unicorn also gains Forester. Raise Dead (cost 40/-) – Research cost is decreased to 1800 (from previously 1920). NEW: Hierophany (cost 23/-) – Combat curse with half resistance roll. If resistance roll unsuccessful, unit loses half armor, all immunities, lightning resistance, negate first strike, and all mobility-related perks. Prayer (cost 40/-) – Now grants +1 attack, armor and resistance when stacked with high prayer (to hit and to defend do not stack). Research cost is increased to 2200 (from previously 2140). NEW: Simurgh (cost -/140, 3 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 4 Life spell books.
PDF page 87 Life Rare Spells Prosperity (cost -/120, 2 upkeep) – The spell is retained its characteristic from Caster of Magic for Windows. NEW: Inquisition (cost -/200, 4 upkeep) – Life gets 1 city curse, but not a traditional one. Inquisition penalizes religious centers (for religious power beyond 6, each additional point reduces research by 3 and adds ½ unrest). This city curse causes a minimum of 2 unrest, but unrest penalty will exceed it if religious power of cursed city exceeds 10. Its high cost and effect on average towns disappoint, but with ideal targets it will eliminate all research, weaken Uranus blessing, and punish Ruler of Heaven, Dark Ritual, by causing considerable unrest. NEW: Heart of Solidarity (cost -/500, 15 upkeep) – Global Enchantment that eliminates unrest penalty from racial relations and garrisons that are not full (morale treated as if full garrisons were in every town). It will help boost taxes without harming your conquered cities, which suffer from racial unrest and small garrisons. The spell is game changing when playing with or conquering klackons or goblins. Exaltation (cost 25/-) – casting cost is decreased (from previously 30) while retained its healing effect. Research cost is increased to 3000 (from previously 2800). NEW: Angelic Guardians (cost -/500, 35 upkeep) – Global enchantment that in combat, it gives all normal units under your command the ability to exorcise at -0, all life and sanctified units under your command the ability to exorcise at -1, and if the unit already has exorcise ability, it gains added -2 strength (normal units) or added -3 strength (life unit). Note that undead units suffer -3 extra penalty, making this global enchantment extremely dangerous for death wizards! Mass Healing (cost 35/-) – Research cost is decreased to 3500 (from previously 4000). Divine Order (cost -/600, 30 upkeep) – Originally underwhelming with the chance of backfiring in you. Cost penalties of +25% for attack spells, unit and city curses apply only to enemy wizards. 25% cost bonuses apply to buffs and healing spells. Additional 10% cost bonuses and penalties apply to global spells while summons cost 10% more. All cost increases affect opponents only so it would only limit opponent but caster still retain option to continue their preferred strategy. Two additional small effects also introduced: +1unrest penalty and half power income from magic markets to wizards with fewer life books than non-life books (+2 unrest and no magic market bonus if wizard has no life books at all!). Due to spell becomes more powerful, trade value of this spell is increased significantly. Angel (cost -/310, 8 upkeep) – Spell and creature is more or less the same as it was in Caster of Magic for Windows. The only difference is now summon artwork is more beautiful. Invulnerability (cost 30/150, 5 upkeep) – The spell is the same as it was in Caster of Magic for Windows. Lionheart (cost 36/180, 3 upkeep) – The spell is the same as it was in Caster of Magic for Windows. NEW: Pillar of Faith (cost -/180, 5 upkeep) – City buff that gives 20% of granting lucky to recruited units and +1 to +8 Resistance depending on how many religious buildings you have in it. This allows wizard an opportunity to gain a lucky unit to cast common tier buffs and addresses the loss of permanent discipline early in game. It also generates 0.5 overland casting skill for each unrest reduction generates by religious buildings. Altar of Battle (cost -/275, 5 upkeep) – Casting cost is decreased (from previously 300) and research cost is decreased to 3800 (from previously 4400). Inspirations (cost -/150, 4 upkeep) – Research cost is increased to 4600 (from 3200). NEW: Valkyries (cost -/370, 9 upkeep) – A flying teleporting support unit with +2 resist to all, 2 charges of exaltation, flying teleporting, and decent melee stats. A similar role as unicorn, but far superior. Holy Word (cost 60/-) – Research cost is increased to 5200 (from previously 4800). Incarnation (cost -/700, 15 upkeep) – Research cost is increased to 5500 (from previously 5200) and upkeep is increased to 15 (from previously 12). The hero is no longer the “Chosen”, but now the “Avatar”.
PDF page 88 Holy Arms (cost -/600, 10 upkeep) – Reserch cost is increased to 5800 (from previously 5600). The spell was used to be Very Rare in original Master of Magic and Caster of Magic for DOS. The spell is moved down to rare tier since Caster of Magic for Windows and this continues in Warlord mod. New: Eye of Heaven (cost 60/-) – new rare tier Life realm combat enchantment, grants all friendly units True Sight. The spell used to be only castable by Life creatures but now transfer to be castable by wizard instead.
PDF page 89 Life Very Rare or Higher Spells Consecration (cost -/200, 2 upkeep) – Enchanted city now produces bless to newly recruited units (only if cathedral or temple exists in city). Research cost is increased to 8000 (from previously 6000) Enlightenment (cost -/900, 50 upkeep) – the research bonus is reduced by half. However, newly produced units now come with 'discipline'. This can be very useful when you have 'altar of battle' or 'crusade + warlord'. Upkeep was increased to 50 to compensate for this powerful new effect, despite the halved research effect. Phoenix (cost -/450, 12 upkeep) – this underwhelming creature was given some fire breath, immolation and slightly higher defense stats. Research cost is decreased to 10000 (from previously 12000). Destiny → Apotheosis (cost -/360, 10 upkeep) – Casting cost is decreased (from previously 400) , and could removes no-healing status from an undead unit. Trade value of the spell is increased slightly while research cost is decreased to 12000 (from previously 15000). Ruler of Heaven (cost -/1000, 25 upkeep) – Now adds 50 combat skill points for every religious power in your cities, thus fully developed religious centers may gain about half of the effect of 'linking Towers' thanks to this spell. Research cost is increased to 14000 (from previously 12000). High Prayer (cost 70/-) – Now High Prayer’s and Prayer’s could stack but not at full effect (as discussed earlier). Life Force (cost -/900, 40 upkeep) – The spell is retained its characteristic from Caster of Magic for Windows. Supreme Light (cost 70/-) – Research cost is decreased to 16000 (from previously 18000). Call to Arms → Spirit of Chivalry (cost 80/-) – It didn't feel 'awesome' for a very rare spell to summon an already-existing normal unit. What this spell summons is a hero-like life unit with supportive effects and paladin- like stats, albeit as a single-figure unit. It is overall superior to a 0-experience paladin, thus comes with a higher cost (from previously 70). However, do not expect it to single-highhandedly win battles late in the game. It remains a spell that boosts surrounding units and can be used as desperation if what you need is an additional melee unit in play. Research cost is increased to 18000 (from previously 15000). Crusade (cost -/1200, 20 upkeep) – Cities with armorer's guild + cathedral/temple grant holy armor to newly produced unit. All those building requirements must be met for this added effect, so only some races can benefit and only if you dedicate the time to construct these buildings. This can help reduce spell buff micromanagement by providing holy armor to some units. Arch Angel (cost -/600, 18 upkeep) – Now Arch Angel can cast hierophany in addition to caster 29, mostly for flavor. Charm of Life (cost -/1500, 30 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 22000 (from previously 24000). NEW: Life Mastery (reform, effect taken upon researched) – Increases enchantment dispel resistance, reduces casting cost of the spells, and buff creature of the Life realm under wizard control. This reform is only available to Specialist retort holder with Life as primary realm. Once this spell appears on research page, it will exclude chance to get mastery of other realm. NEW: Seraph (cost -/999, 30 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 12 Life spell books. NEW: Power of Life (cost 55/-) – This spell could only be learned by Enchanter wizard who already have access to Bless, Heroism, Holy Armor, Holy Weapon, Endurance, Divine Protection, True Sight, Lionheart, and Invulnerability. This spell would allow the Enchanter to cast all above unit enchantment all at once on single target! NEW: Day of Life (cost 150/-) – This spell could only be learned by Runemaster wizard who already have access to True Light, Eye of Heaven, Prayer, High Prayer, and Supreme Light. This spell would allow the Runemaster to cast all above combat enchantment all at once!
PDF page 90 Death: A heavily adjusted realm, given its underwhelming performance by players and opponent wizards. More opportunities for raising undead were introduced throughout all stages of the game. Reliance on plentiful and cheap undead armies, best amassed by defensive and calculating players, is a feature of Death. This helps overwhelm the enemy with sheer numbers while building up your city garrison unit counts across the world at little to no cost. Alongside your large armies of arguably weaker units you have various curse and debuff tools at your disposal. Death gameplay is the opposite of life gameplay: it relies on weakening the enemy to win the game, rather than strengthening itself. This theme applies to units, cities, and wizards themselves. Death realm no longer associated with poison damage. Note: Cult Leader now grants +100% power bonus from religious buildings, but dark rituals redesigned and stacks less significantly. Removed Death Spells Final Wave – Now resistance roll of -1 (from 0), due to more opportunities to raise resistance in Warlord mod, and top tier units innately having higher resistance. Death Common Spells Skeletons (cost -/25, 0 upkeep) – There is no change in spell and creature itself but ai has more incentive to cast the spell. Weakness (cost 8/-) – Casting cost is increased (from previously 7) and now the curse has no resistance roll. The curse also has additional reduction of breath strength. This is now one of Death's staple common-tier curse spells and worth picking as a starting common. Cloak of Fear (cost 12/60, 1 upkeep) – Trade value is increased slightly while research cost is descreased to 240 (from 260). Black Sleep (cost 15/-) – Trade value is decreased significantly due to it is only useful early and mid game. Research cost is decreased to 240 (from previously 320). Zombies (cost 24/-, 0 upkeep) – Received a 'resident evil update', now move 2 and have 5 base attack. These are now a more reliable tool for raising undead (including with zombie mastery). These are also a higher threat as rampaging monsters and lair defenders (their value increased). Casting cost is increased to 24 (from previously 20) and research cost is decreased to 280 (from previously 320). Life Drain (cost 10/-) – Research cost is decreased to 280 (from previously 320). Ghouls (cost -/80, 1 upkeep) – Casting of the spell is lower (from previously 88). The unit get overhaul with +10% to hit, but without poison. Death no longer involved in poison damage. Research cost is reduced to 320 (from previously 380). Darkness (cost 20/-) – The spell is not changed from Caster of Magic for Windows. Wraith Form (cost 11/55, 2 upkeep) – unchanged but weapon immunity now grants +10 armor and wraithform is the only common-tier source of weapon immunity (fire elemental buffed and moved to uncommon-tier). Research cost is decreased to 360 (from previously 440). Misfortune → Liability (cost 13/-) – Research cost is decreased to 400 (from previously 480).
PDF page 91 Death Uncommon Spells Blood Lust → Bloodlust (cost 21/63, 0 upkeep) – Research is decreased to 500 (from previously 640) and trade value is decreased. The spell is no longer grants the various immunities and enchanted units can heal naturally (if enchanted overland). Blood Lust can be cast in combat for 21 cost. This is a great benefit for mono- death wizards who lack tools to defeat blessed units and now you no longer have to deal with the consequences of enchanted unit becoming undead. If cast on an appropriate melee unit next to a hero or other valuable normal unit, it can turn the tide of battle. Lycanthropy (cost -/95, 2 upkeep) – Werewolves gains Forester, +1 resistance, and Rage ability (+1 Attack strength for each fallen figure in the unit), and cost 10 less (95 mana). Trade value of the spell is decreased but research cost is increased to 700 (from previously 420). The cost of sacrificing a unit (spearmen more expensive in mod), the higher research cost (700 from 420) led to lycanthropy being a disappointing spell. With small bonuses and a lower cost, it should stay competitive. Night Stalker (cost -/225, 1 upkeep) – Now the creature has stealth, because it is already invisible. Research cost is decreased to 900 (from previously 1920). Mana Leak (cost 20/-) – Research cost is decreased to 1000 (from previously 1280). Syphon Life (cost 30/-) – Research cost is decreased to 1100 (from previously 1280). New: Shadow Strike (cost 18/90, 2 upkeep) – This death uncommon unit enchantment, grant unit thrown attack at strength 1/3 of melee strength. If thrown already a unit trait, then gain 1/3 of melee strength as additional thrown damage. Ability to hit flyers is not a death realm trait, but this spell grants an opportunity to do so for your ground military. While this all sounds underwhelming for the cost, please note that thrown is an additional attack, therefore abilities like poison or life steal get to trigger twice while attacking! Warp Node (cost -/120) – moved to uncommon-tier to grant death realm an economy boost spell in early to mid game that is not overly powerful, but can harm opponents as a bonus. Trade value and research cost are decreased to proportional to its current uncommon status. Possession (cost 35/-) – Research cost is increased to 1400 (from previously 1280). Black Prayer (cost 35/-) – Trade value is decreased significantly. Wall of Darkness (cost 30/90, 1 upkeep) – Research cost is increased to 1800 (from previously 960) and trade value is increased slightly. Shadow Demons (cost -/175, 4 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 2000 (from previously 2140) and trade value is decreased. New: Revenant (cost 25/-) – New death uncommon combat unit enchantment, grant unit melee death touch 0 and regeneration 1 but unit permanently becomes undead. Note that death touch triggers once per attacking figure, becoming devastating when using multi-figure melee units against lower resistance units. Death touch does not apply to ranged attacks. This spell is also useful for preserving units you expect to die in combat while enjoying the benefits of undead (added immunities, synergy with darkness). NEW: Werewolves (cost 30/-, 2 upkeep) – Different from Lycanthropy, this spell is combat summon version. This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 4 Death spell books.
PDF page 92 Death Rare Spells Drain Power (cost -/100) – Trade value is increased slightly. Reaper Slash (cost 44/-) – The spell is now on rare-tier. The spell is damaging with cold undead-raising damage, rather than poison. Strength increased to 22 (60% hit chance). Death no longer associated with poison damage. Trade value is increased slightly and research cost adjusted to 2600 (from previously 1280) as it is now rare tier spell. Evil Presence (cost -/200, 3 upkeep) – Casting cost is increased (from previously 180) and trade value is significantly increased. The spell does not only prevent units from being recruited with experience or magic weapons, but now also prevents positive recruitment effects introduced by warlord mod, such as effects from Survival Instinct, free disciplines/resist elements, doom mastery, etc Drought (cost -/200, 3 upkeep) – Casting cost is increased (from previously 150) as now the spell also reduces city food production by 25% and newly recruited units, malnourished, are debuffed with 1 less melee and 2 less armor. Trade value is decreased slightly and research cost is decreased to 3000 (from previously 3200). Wraiths (cost -/250, 5 upkeep) – Casting cost is cheaper (from previously 350) and research cost decreased significantly to 3200 (from previously 4800). But this comes with weaker stats, particularly in the melee compartment. This may increase the chances (with black prayer) to raising undead. Earlier versions of mod has guaranteed raise undead, but the ability was instead given to Vampire (more thematic). Trade value is decreased slightly as result. Dark Rituals (cost -/150, 0 upkeep) – Now grants 8 base power + 100% of religious power (instead of 0 +200% religious power) due to major stacking imbalances around other mod changes. Research cost is decreased to 3500 (from previously 4000). Terror (cost 40/-) – Research cost is decreased to 3800 (from 4000). Fate Mastery → Dance of Death (cost -/444, 17 upkeep) – The spell is moved from Chaos realm to Death realm due to it fits better under death, can help boost some of the curse combat spells. Moved to rare tier for better progression on resistance-reducing effects. Research cost is increased to 4000 to match its current status as rare tier spell. Trade value is also increased significantly due to how important the spell is for Death realm playstyle. NEW: State of Rot (cost -/600, 30 upkeep) – New global enchantment, all enemy non-undead units in combat lose regeneration, cannot heal in combat. Additionally, your undead units outside of combat heal by 3hp per turn. Gate of Hades (cost 40/-) – The spell does not change from Caster of Magic for Windows. NEW: Arch Liches (cost -/360, 8 upkeep) – New Death rare tier summon creature. These dark priests of the Death are combination of priest, magisters, and ghouls with ability to cast death realm spells, grant Resistance for all, deal long range attack with life steal, and summon a lot of zombie to aid the combat. This creature is a great aid to death realm that overall suffer from low resistance. Vampire → Vampire Lord (cost -/395, 10 upkeep) – Slightly name change to make them classier and match with another newly added spell in term of theme. The creature now has Lower hp, regeneration, and melee output. However, it now has higher resistance and comes with a free charge of syphon life to assist with self- healing and undead creation and the vampire is guaranteed to raise undead via melee damage. Trade value is increased to match its new additional role as main undead creator and research cost is decreased to 4300 (from previously 4400). NEW: Soul Flay (cost 45/-) – Combat irresistible curse to normal units or heroes that reduces 1 melee, 2 armor and 2 resistance for each experience level (-2 recruit, -8 elite for armor and resistance). This spell can be devastating for heroes that leveled up 5+ times and ultra-elite or champion units, most commonly seen from life wizards. This spell now establishes itself as the ultimate anti-hero tool, taking the place of 'crack's call'
PDF page 93 Wave of Despair (cost 72/-) – Trade value is decreased significantly and research cost is decreased to 4900 New: Vampirism (cost -/100, 3 upkeep) – New Death very rare overland unit enchantment, normal unit becomes undead, cannot gain experience (but heroism still able to buff them), creates undead, gains bloodsucker, and has all thrown/breath transferred to melee and reduced thrown/breath strength to 1 (so it still able to attack air). Note that enchanted unit cannot gain experience so keep this drawback in mind when casting this spell on heroes. The thrown/breath shift to melee was done to reduce abusable double-triggering of blood sucker. Summon Demon (cost 50/150, 3 upkeep) – A slightly name changes and move down the spell from very rare to now a rare-tier spell. Casting cost is increased to 50 (from previously 41) to prevent positive return of casting skill by summoning them in combat. Demon also comes with slightly increased stats and the ability to raise undead via melee damage. It is also a more expensive spell. It is difficult for it to win battles with mediocre melee stats, thus proven not to be game breaking. The most reliable raise-undead feature from the original unit (caster 40, thus 4 life drains or syphon life) remains. This is also an indirect enhancement to Demon Lord. Research cost is decreased to 5500 (from previously 6000) but research priority is significantly higher. Zombie mastery (cost -/800, 40 upkeep) – This global enchantment (now more costly to maintain) grants +1 to stats, including movement, to zombies and undead units to further enhance your undead-raising gameplay. Research cost is increased to 5800 (from previously 5600) and trade value is increased significantly as result. NEW: Necropolis (cost -/200, 4 upkeep) – New rare tier economic-oriented city enchantment for Death realm, turn city of the livings into city of the deads binding to the wizard's will. Population units no longer affect by Unrest and no longer Growth or Shrinkage normally. All newly trained units from the city become Undead. In combat, Necropolis is protected by Gate of Hades combat enchantment. NEW: Ghost Ship (cost -/220, 4 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 6 Death spell books.
PDF page 94 Death Very Rare or Higher Spells Animate Dead (cost 50/-) – Research cost is decreased significantly to 8000 (from previously 15000). Ruler of Underworld (cost -/1300, 50 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 8000 (from previously 10000). The spell now grants +4 religious power for each oracle in play (consults the dead), helping pay upkeep and allowing minor combos with cult leader and ruler of heaven. Additionally, mod mechanics make it more usable (weapon immunity boosted to +10 effect, more relevance of top-tier melee normal units) Cloud of Shadow (cost -/250, 5 upkeep) – The spell is move up tier to very rare from previously rare tier. Its trade value increased significantly along with casting costs increased (from previously 200). Research cost and trade value increased significantly to match up with its current status as very rare spell. Death Knights (cost -/420, 8 upkeep) – The creature get 1 spell charge of Cloak of Fear. Trade value is slightly decreased. Massacre (cost 60/-) – Research cost is decreased to 14000 (from previously 15000). A nnihilate (cost 41/-) – The spell has not changed from Caster of Magic for Windows. Pestilence (cost -/250, 5 upkeep) – The city enchantment was powerful in theory, but difficult to properly use, invalidating the claim that it 'wins the game'. The population killing rate of this spell has been increased substantially, making it the ultimate economy-killing spell in the game. The spell has also gain new use as combat debuff as garrison would suffer plague debuff in combat. Research cost increase (from 8000 to 15000) was necessary to delay its introduction and require significant investments given the impact it has on the game. Darkest Hour (cost -/1200, 40 upkeep) – the underwhelming global enchantment now comes with 3 unrest to all opponent cities (and can stack with +2 when multiple versions in play), adding to the negative economy impact. Wizard who casts darkest hour is immune to other wizards' darkest hour unrest effect. Research cost is increased to 16000 (from previously 15000). Eternal Night (cost -/1000, 24 upkeep) – In addition to the original effects, now makes all enemy non-death units lose 2 range (poor sight) during combat as long as spell is in effect. Trade value and casting cost are increased (from 800) as result. Death Reckoning (cost -/1000, 30 upkeep) – Evil Omens (cost -/1250, 25 upkeep) – now second or later copies give additional 25% casting cost and effect could be prevented by own a copy of Evil Omens. Demon Lord (cost -/666, 18 upkeep) – Research cost is decreased to 22000 (from previously 24000). NEW: Death Mastery (reform, effect taken upon researched) – Increases enchantment dispel resistance, reduces casting cost of the spells, and buff creature of the Death realm under wizard control. This reform is only available to Specialist retort holder with Death as primary realm. Once this spell appears on research page, it will exclude chance to get mastery of other realm. NEW: Arch Demon Lord (cost -/999, 30 upkeep) – This spell could only be learned with Conjuring Pact and 12 Death spell books. NEW: Power of Death (cost 88/-) – This spell could only be learned by Enchanter wizard who already have access to Cloak of Fear, Wraith Form, Bloodlust, Shadow Strike, Revenant, and Vampirism. This spell would allow the Enchanter to cast all above unit enchantment all at once on single target! NEW: Night of Death (cost 150/-) – This spell could only be learned by Runemaster wizard who already have access to Darkness, Mana Leak, Black Prayer, Terror, and Gate of Hades. This spell would allow the Runemaster to cast all above combat enchantment all at once!
PDF page 95 Other Gameplay Changes Overland global spells cost more in games with higher # of opponents and larger land size than average. Overland spells that are individual-based or localized cost slightly less in games with higher # of opponents and larger land size. Spell text now includes pictures that represents such spells. Road and city tiles cost 0.5 movement point, but are more difficult to build. AI wizards have altered decision-making, particularly when it comes to rush-buying buildings. They are now discouraged (rather than strongly encouraged) to rush-buy wizard guild, amplifying tower, linking tower. Combat terrain in forest and nature node has 55% rough terrain (from 95% and 35%, respectively) while mountain and chaos node has 35% of rough terrain (from 8%). Weapon immunity now grants +10 armor against non-magic weapons. - First turn one could obtain 'rare' or 'very rare' spell in treasure much earlier. It is more common to earn gold and mana rewards from lairs and less common to earn weak artifacts. Advanced rewards such as high-tier spells, picks, vials, and hero prisoners require a higher minimum reward treshhold, but only consumes a portion of this minimum, allowing space for other rewards (e.g. gold, mana, items) Neutral-only unit additions, such as the return of manticores, storm giants, sprites and a new 'ghost ship'. Manticores no longer have weapon immunity. Unit mercenaries can be hired as early as turn 18 (from 30), helping out wizards with benefactor (aka. famous) and charismatic retorts. Items and heroes still show up no earlier than turn 30. Aether Flux cost reduction effect weakened from 50% reduction to 33% reduction. Good/Bad Moon religion power effect weakened, from -50% and +100% effects to -33% and +50% effects. Rampage-only Lord Units Lesser Chaos/Gaia/Aether Lords will begin showing up as rampaging monsters if game goes for too long. - Lesser Lords are boss-type monsters that combine many traits of their respective realms and can single- handedly defeat unprepared armies – these show up around final Spell of Mastery stage of the game. -The greater lords (and a Seraph and an Arch Demon Lord) show up even later with greater stats, spellcasting abilities and realm traits. Experience Level Bonuses +1 mp for each level of experience Ultra Elite: +5% to hit, +1 attack, +1thrown/breath +1 armor, +1mp (from the underwhelming +1 attack, +1 armor) Champion: +5% to hit, +1 attack, +2 armor, +1 resistance, +1mp (more balanced set of boosts instead of just +10% to hit, +1hp)
PDF page 96 Endgame Although the mod has no set time limit about how long game would drag long but there are a few factors that would limit how long you could keep playing in single playthrough. 1) Rampaging Monsters Rampaging monster will become more and more powerful as game continue and at some point monster would become too powerful to deal with any place and anywhere. This could be lessen by clear out monster lairs that kept spawning monsters but presence of Nature Embrace make the stream of monsters go on. If your wizard does not have Nature Embrace, those monsters would overwhelm you at some point of the game as Lords class monsters coming along with monster rampaging stack. In advanced difficulty, this could occur around year 1525 (turn 300 onward) and this could occur in year 1513 (turn 150 onward) in highest difficulty like Phantasm. PDF page 97 New Game+ There are many options to play and deal with more difficult challenge in Warlord mod as scoring options add over Caster of Magic included. 1) Desolated Outpost: Outpost growth of each races are depending on their favorable/unfavorable terrains surrounding the outpost. This condition is more punishing for player especially in higher difficulty due to AI have outpost growth bonus increases for each difficulty. 2) Gods Play Dices: At the start of combat, each unit rolls for resistance penalties between -2 and +2 3) Unstoppable Stampede: In combat, all neutral Fantastic creatures gain Regeneration 0. 4) Nodeborne Souls: All nodes have combat enchantment attached to them. Nodes also grant Common or Uncommon unit enchantments from the same realm as the node to all defending neutral creatures. 5) Cosmic Chessboard: Any combat involving neutral Life or Death Fantastic creatures will trigger intervention from gods of their side, granting common or uncommon combat enchantments and unit enchantments to support their minions. 6) Uphill Battle: Whenever AI units are in combat against the human player, those units gain +10% To-Hit, +10% To-Defend, and +1 Resistance. 7) Khan the Conqueror: Neutral units will fight as if their commander has the Warlord and Tactician retorts. 8) You Too, Adamantium: All opponent wizards start with access to adamantium ore and free Alchemist’s Guild in their starting city. 9) You Too, Orihalcon: All opponent wizards start with access to orihalcon ore and free Alchemist’s Guild in their starting city. 10) Demon King’s Castle: Opponent wizard have extravagant fortress as if they are final boss in JRPG. All opponent wizards start the game with City Wall, Hillfort, Fortification, Baray, Undercity Hive Network, and Tree of Life in the fortress. Although all of these buildings are destructable, these buildings would be built along with new fortress every time those opponents cast Spell of Return! The tile beneath the fortress of opponent will convert into volcano unless the tile is a river. Opponent fortress would receive upkeep refund from these buildings as long as it last. 11) No Secret in Mastery: Disable Spell of Mastery victory condition as no one will have it. 12) Among Us…: There is chance that some master wizards are mysterious outlandish identities with strange tricks. At least one AI wizard is designated as an outlander with following characteristic. - Starts with no book and no magic spell but retained all picked retorts and spells gain from retort. - Starts with Tree of Knowledge has already been researched. - Start with 1 Overland Casting Skill and 0 Combat Casting Skill. Base casting skill is only available after gains a spell book and grows at half rate of normal. - Gains access to researchable exclusive to the outlander. - Requires 4 Magic Books to able to research Spell of Mastery. 13) The Lord of the Magics: One of your opponents is ancient tyrant lord of magics who has already casted Spell of Mastery once and earned mastery over all magic spells. Only things that prevent this Dark Lord from instant victory are facts that their power weaken and casting skill gone rusty from slumber for too long, they yet to gathered followers and build up power base after all their properties scattered throughout the planes, and they need long preparation to cast Spell of Mastery again to assert absolute dominance in this era!
PDF page 98 Change Logs: Version 1.5.12.6 Important: • New Scoring option: No Secret in Mastery, removed Spell of Mastery from Gameplay and no wizard would able to researched this spell. • New Scoring option: Desolated Outpost, terrain which outpost build upon and area surrounding it has strong influence on survival and growth of the outpost. Each races have different favorable terrain which usually based on their unique building requirements and their generic lore. • New Scoring option: Accelerated Race, remove turn number requirement from Rare and Very Rare spell rewards. • New Scoring option: Wizard of Oz, the human player wizard starts the game as outlander with no magic and spell books (only retort retained) except Tree of Knowledge has already researched. What the wizard get in compensate is unique technology research and application. • New Scoring option: Among Us…., at least one AI opponent is an outlander technologist. You could considered this wizard as boss level threat. They are the strongest opponent if you left them for too long. • New Scoring option: Return of the Master, human player wizard starts with all spells in spell book have already researched except special spells from retort, outlander technologies, and Spell of Mastery. • New Scoring option: The Lord of the Magics, one of the AI opponent start with 4 spellbooks in each realm and all magic spells (include realm magic spell that lock behind retort) have already researched except Spell of Mastery, and special reform and arcane spells from retort, as well as outlander’s technologies. This opponent is also boss level material due to their fortress is usually guarded with Lord/forbidden level fantastic creatures. • Now Scoring option: Book Collectors will also give spells apart from books in loser’s collection in similar manner to gains magic book from lair with some minor difference. The winner will roll for spell from the list available on loser’s pool first. If spell that taken have not yet researched or already appear on research page, the loser will permanently lose that spell. If not enough available spell to fill the quota, winner will gain spell for the rest of quota at random. • Now Scoring option: Everything Nice will now also excluded new addition spells in Warlord mod. But if get excluded spells as reward from lair will have this spell removed immediately and get no compensation for losing spell this way. • Now any wizard who loses all their magic books will lose access to personal casting skill (base casting skill = 0). There is some exception on overland casting skill, it will never fall down below 1 (or game would crash when access magic casting menu). • Due to some players complain that difficulty of this mod is too low and bonus AI receive could not keep up with difficulty scoring options add to the mod, the Difficulty of the mod above Advanced level have been adjusted. AI on Phantasmal level will receive bonus as much as Phantasmal level in CoM for Windows and the difficulty on Expert, Master, and Lunatic are scale down from this proportionally between Advanced and Phantasmal level. Other • Game text fixes • no longer displaying 'disoriented' warp reality icon on unit from chaos blessing • Some unit sprites and other graphics reworked • Coliseum recolored • Tundra terrain has a small chance of having wild game Version 1.4.22 Economy: - New game mechanic called 'indirect control penalty': Non-Capital Cities less productive, losing 20% of production/gold/gold/power rounded down . - If wizard is banished, all cities become much less productive, losing 40% of production/gold/power/food - Buildings, particularly non-military non-production ones, have lower upkeeps with many starter buildings having 0 upkeep. This accommodates for the generally higher building costs relative to Caster of Magic. A fully developed city may save up to 20 gold per turn. - However, military units have higher upkeeps, typically +1 except for higher-tiers gaining +2 or even +3 gold upkeep. - Ships also now come with gold upkeep just like original Master of Magic. Lower-tier ship upkeep stays low. - Library provides 4 research (from 6) - Magic Market provides 4 power (from 6) End Turn Time Savings - Unitcalc and unitcalcpre script file overhauled to perform more efficient calculations - EnterCombat removed to improve end turn waits considerably. - economy and other script files adjusted to lessen end turn waits - Tactician makes fewer calculations in strategic (automatic combat), which reduces end turns. Races: - Lizardmen now allowed to build bank – needed an economic buff to stay competitive. Spells: - wall of fire redesigned to deal stronger damage but as a single attack, no longer targets all figures. - wall of fire also grants +1 attack to all defending normal units (metal fires effect from original game) - wall of fire costs 30 if cast in combat. - wall of fire overland cost unchanged but now has 1 upkeep - Blaze of glory now also grants armor-piercing (needed a significant buff to be usable) but unit enchanted loses first strike (if present) - Flame Blade, renamed fiery fury, if cast on a fantastic creature, turns the creature to chaos and grants first strike and +3 fire breath. - Rust also eliminates 'thrown' attack to cursed unit. - Chaos Blessing also offers protection by granting -10% to hit to non-chaos attackers - Power Link now also eliminates all non-capital power penalties introduced in version 1.4.22 - Firebolt costs 9 (from 10) - Dissolution costs 80 (from 90) - Mariner Mastery uses fewer calculations. When dispelled it takes a full turn to take effect. - Wraithform no longer allows ships to travel and transport units inland - Immolation now boosts existing firebreath by +3. Units without fire-breath do not gain this bonus. - Dance of Death no longer grants random 'liability' to enemy units – affected end turn waits too much - Angelic Guardians no longer grants random 'lucky' to friendly units. Spell grants additional exorcise bonuses. (normal -0, life/sanctified -1, existing exorcise gains additional -2) Buildings:
PDF page 136 - Farmer's Market - Instead of granting food, Farmer's Market grants 0.5 gold per population. - Forester's Guild - Grants 4 food and +2 food bonus from wild game Units: - Fire Giant loses 1 ammo, gains 1 armor and 2hp … becomes roughly as useful as the fireball casting variant of original. - Maiden Queen costs 240 (+40) - Stag Beetle costs 1 less upkeep than a typical 240 cost unit. Wizards: - Artificer no longer has 25% cost reduction of arcane spells. However, all mechanical units (not just slow ones) gain +1 movement and all mechanical units also gain +1 attack, +1 armor and +2 resistance. (from +2,+0,+1) - Runemaster now 1-pick retort, loses spell resistance perk, arcane research reduction weakened to 25%, gains 25% cost reduction of arcane spells. - Spellweaver renamed to Enchanter, now 2-pick retort, gains the 150% spell resistance perk and 25% cost reduction in all enchantment and curse spells overland and in combat. - Sagemaster no longer grants gold based on research buildings, but its 25% research bonus was upgraded to 33% research bonus. Death no longer associated with poison. Spells: - Fireball moved back to uncommon, costs 19, requires 1280 research cost, and has strength 14 (from 12) - Blaze of glory moved to common. See race section for more details. Units: - Seraph introduced as a non-summonable unit of great difficulty similar to the 'greater lords' that spawn very late in the game and guard the most valuable treasure. - Nightmare loses the caster 20 and gain 1 charge of 'terror' Spells: - Inquisition does no longer cause unrest from religious 'violence' power from Chaos Embrace - Aether Sink cause a minimum of 5 power loss. - Unicorn costs 10 less - Valkyrie costs 20 more and 1 more upkeep - State of Rot disallows all healing for enemy non-undead units in combat, essentially making all damage irrecoverable. - Nature's witness nightshade generate 4 power instead of 6 (was being counted twice) - NEW Power Link (cost 1200/upk 50) – Power Link has been completely changed, including spell image. It now • grants 5 power per city enchantment (15 if city curse) in all your cities • grants 2 overland skill per enemy Amplifying Tower in play • grants full effect of all enemy monuments and linking towers to your combat skill • makes dispel-type spells +100% effective. If combined with Aether Binding, it simulates old game's 'True' dispel spells. • Reason: The original spell was too 'mathematical', caused variable power spikes that could heavily impact domination score and the 'win' button, was too overpowered if obtained early or there are too many players, and didn't seem to affect enemy spell decision logic. The new Power Link has more strategic components while still scaling reasonably well with more players. Spells: - Warp Lightning renamed to Lightning Rage - New warp lightning spell taking its place is a 18-strength lightning damage to all figures, providing a more advanced spell hitting all figures when facing buffed multi-figure units. - Doom Mastery also grants all 3 chaos channel effects if chaos channels cast on a hero - Insulation now costs 18/90 (from 12/60) – was too effective. - Exaltation now costs 25 (from 30) – a true upgrade from healing in all circumstances, allows champion casters access to it. - Blood Lust now costs 21 in combat (from 25) and 63 overland (from 50) – the removal of undead effect made it too useful to mass-cast, yet the combat spell was too expensive and out of reach from caster units. This is a reasonable compromise. - Minor spell cost adjustments, mainly to add incentive to using elite and ultra elite caster 20 units. - Immolation now costs 13 (from 12), Blaze of Glory 23 (from 25) - Iron skin now costs 23 (from 24), ice bolt 24 (from 25) - Blur costs 24 (from 25) - Exorcise now costs 18 (from 20), hierophany now costs 23 (from 24) - Inquisition now grants a minimum of 2 unrest to cursed city - Teleport spell now grants the effect in combat only (decreased end turn wait times) - Blood lust code more efficient, decreased end turn wait time. - Bless now grants 4 resistance and 7 armor against chaos/death effects (from +3 to each with additional +1 resist) AI: - Chances of wizards starting with 'Specialist' decreased. - Disjunct prioritization has been recalibrated across the board with a higher emphasis for disjunctioning economy based global enchantments when at peace, disjunctioning military-oriented global enchantments when at war, and other balancing on this matter.
