PDF page 139 - Minotaur gains +1 hp - Doom Drake costs 10 less - Kraken no longer stealthy in sea (end turn time savings) - Archangel has a charge of hierophany (new spell) AI: - Overhauled how AI values spells in regards to trading with other players, more in line with spell worth and whether the spell is not used at its full potential by dumb AI. Spells: - Soul flay costs 45 (from 5) - Lycanthropy costs 90 (from 105) and has resistance 5 (from 4) - Divine Order's magic market effect changed from guaranteed to conditional – if opponent has no life books, it no longer provides power. If opponent has more non-life books than life – magic market is 50% as effective. If opponent has more life books – magic market is unchanged. - nerfed - Plane shift research cost is 6000 (from 8000) - Focus Magic, if cast in combat and unit does not have ranged attack, grants +3 resist. - buffed, mainly to help AI. - Inner Power also grants mountaineer to qualifying units. - Ensuring magic immunity does not counter web - State of Rot Redesigned without 'healing immunity' at all given the various bugs around it not expected to be fixed - All enemy non-undead units in combat lose regeneration and 8% to defend. Additional State of Rot enchantments in play reduces to defend by 4%. - Sanctify effect to turn unit into life creature only happens during battle (end turn time savings) - Angelic Guardians effect of giving your units exorcise only happens during battle (end turn time savings) -AI values some spells slightly more or less when trading. - Removed Purity due to impact on end turn processing. - NEW UNCOMMON - hierophany (24 cost) – Combat curse with -4 resist modifier (-7 if undead). If resistance roll unsuccessful, unit loses half armor, all immunities, lightning resistance, negate first strike, and all mobility-related perks. This spell is most successful against death and undead units which happen to have some of these perks. - Focus magic no longer can be cast in combat (end turn time savings) - Vampirism no longer transfers thrown/breath into range, only into melee (end turn time savings and to encouraging melee among enchanted units) Other: - This version is all about lowering end turn game speeds, a problem associated with the Warlord mod. The scripts simplified to reduce calculations. In some cases, certain features got simplified or moved to just combat-only effects. S implified eternal night/state of rot/vampiricism/shadow strike/colossal strength/Temporal Twist. Version 1.4.17 Retort/Books: - Spellweaver's cost reduction is 20% (from 25%) for non-enchantment overland spells (enchantments still 25%) - Channeler also comes with 12% combat spell cost reduction (all spells but only if cast in combat) - Artificer's mechanical unit trait involves +1 resistance (from +2) - Charismatic now also grants 1 unrest reduction to your cities - Sage Master now eliminates unrest of library, sage guild, and university - Famous renamed to 'Benefactor' now grants heroes +2 attack, +1 armor, and +1 resist. - omniscient formula now 14 + 4X% (from 16 + 3.5X), favoring mono-wizards - omniscient chaos formula now includes wizard fortress and combat skill gains from cities - alchemy named 'alchemist' for consistency in retort names. - bug fix: wizards with 7 or 8 books of one type were not gaining the 3% and 6% spell cost discount as described with latest Caster of Magic version. Spells: - Divine Order costs 600/30 (from 500/10) but calculates bonuses and penalties differently, mostly favoring player (25% cost reduction for buffs and healing spells, +25% cost increase for curses and damage spells that apply only to enemy wizards). Some minor 10% increase/decrease effects elsewhere with the cost increases applying only to opponents. - State of Rot no longer affects units overland (improves wait turn performance). However, there is an added 'to defend' penalty of 5% to enemy units during combat. - State of Rot bug around caster units losing spell books prevented. However, this required making them exempt from the healing immunity effect. To balance it out, caster units lose 8% to defend instead of 5% - State of Rot bug around fantastic units prevented. However, this required making them exempt from the healing immunity effect. To balance it out, caster units lose 8% to defend instead of 5% - Mystic Surge no longer grants 'healing immunity', is full of bugs in unmodded Caster of Magic. - Eternal Night's 'poor vision' effect on enemy units now happen only in combat improves wait turn performance). - Rust now costs 7 (from 8) - Purity may have a slight tweak to improve wait turn performance. Cities/Buildings: - Switching farmer to worker guarantees at least 1 hammer change (impacting non-dwarf/klackon towns that had sawmill but not townhall
PDF page 140 present) - Mechanician Guild redesigned from +40% all production to +1 ½ per worker. In a mid-size city with a few allocated farmers, production output is about the same. However, this makes food upkeep more costly later in game due to opportunity cost. - rewrite code in ecoprod.cas to make sure that all remnant production in the form of fractions from farmers, several buildings, percentage bonus would not be discarded as they get included in result from terrain AI: - If template is mono nature or have nature books more than 4 and not yet have tactician retort, then there is 30% chance for sacrifice one nature book for tactician retort - If wizard has more than two magic realms, chance of picking omniscient retort is increased by # of different book types. - The re-rolling of spell availability now considers new spell combos from Warlord mod. - AI has low-medium disjunct priority to Divine Order (from near-zero) Units: A few hardy recruitable units were rebalanced around 40% to defend to give player a different mega-buff option over multifigures. - Golem: 7 armor (from 9), 40% to defend, +5 cost - Stag Beetle: 6 armor (from 8), 40% to defend - Dragon Turtle: 9 armor (from 11), 24hp (from 25), 40% to defend - Minotaur: 16 melee (from 13), 4 armor (from 5), 12hp (from 13), 40% to hit (from 50%), 40% to defend - Gugalanna: 8 melee (from 10), 50% to hit (from 40%) Experience: MP is earned +1 per level of experience. Ultra Elite: +5% to hit, +1 attack, +1thrown/breath +1 armor, +1mp (from the underwhelming +1 attack, +1 armor. +2mp was present version 1.4.15, but now split as 2 +1s) Champion: +5% to hit, +1 attack, +2 armor, +1 resistance , +1mp (more balanced set of boosts instead of just +10% to hit, +1hp) Heroes: +5% to hit earned in level 4, level 6, level 8 and level 9 (instead of +10% earned in level 5 and 9) Other: - Improved end of turn wait time, especially early in game. - Unit mercenaries can be recruited as early as turn 18 (from turn 30). Heroes and item purchases unchanged. -Description fixes - Fixed air elemental's immunity to hurricane spell. Version 1.4.16 Retort: - Conjurer starts with Summoning Circle - Runemaster starts with Dispel Magic - Artificer allows all mechanical units be recruited with magic weapons (without alchemist guild), +2 resistance and if unit that has speed lower than 3 would gains +1 speed (benefits Steam Cannon, Catapult, Ballista, and Steam Tank). Spells: - State of Rot now also disables 'healer' unit trait when in effect. - Evil Omen cost multiplier now stacks (but at 25 %), but unrest stacking was removed. - Speed reduces by Temporal Twist would not cause unit speed to go below 0.5. Version 1.4.15 Spells: - Tree of Knowledge costs 250 (-150) but research cost is 2000 (+200) - Corruption costs 30 (from 40) to balance out the higher prevalence of purifying units and being able to move them around faster with roads. - New chaos common spell that replaces shatter - “rust” which at a resistance modifier of -5 can remove magic weapons permanently. If cast on a unit without magic weapons and unit fails resistance modifier, it loses half its attack rating - New chaos rare spell (16 th spell) – Shatter cost 20 – now can target creatures, affects all attack types, and comes with modifier -5 - New sorcery rare spell (16 th spell) -Temporal Twist (cost 40) – combat global enchantment – all enemy units lose 1 movement, teleport, first strike, and negate first strike. If unit is fantastic, it loses an additional movement point. - New nature rare spell (16 th spell) – Transmute Equipment Cost 90 – unit special - gives adamantium and orihalcon to a normal unit or a hero. Not an enchantment, thus cannot be dispelled. - New Life rare spell (16 th spell) – Inquisition – penalizes religious centers (for religious power beyond 6, each additional point reduces research by 3 and adds ½ unrest) - Reaper Slash returns as a rare spell with low research cost – death does not specialize in direct damage, but at least it has 1 decent option to do so. - State of Rot expanded to also affect enemy death units as long as they are not undead. - Hell Hounds cost 48 (from 55), intended to be a superior common-tier summon like in original MoM - Magic Immunity now costs 45 to cast in combat
PDF page 141 - Djinn now costs 395/10 (from 375/9) but comes with caster 40 (from 35) - Efreet now has caster 39 (from 40) Building: - Monument no longer has building prerequisites (used to require magic market + library). Dwarves (who have no access to magic market) still can't build it Units: - Griffin now cost 260 (from 280) to recruit - Werewolves, Coatl, Sacred Ancient, and unicorns gain forester - Manticore, Chimera, Great Drake, Sky Drake, Storm Giant, Thunderbird gain mountaineer AI: - True Light prioritized less by AI, partly due to AI not always using spell correctly. Other: Combat terrain in forest/nature nodes has less 55% of rough terrain (from 95% and 35% respectively) while mountain and volcano increased to have 35% of rough terrain (from 8%). - Ultra elite experience grants +2 mana points (reaching 25 for caster 20 units) Tactician redesigned: The wizard has skill maneuvering troops in battlefield. In combat, all units controlled by wizard gain +1 defense. If combat occurs on unit's favorable terrain, it gains +1 movement point. If unit stays on its favorable combat tile, it gains first strike and +2 defense. Units with "Forester" favor overland forest terrain and Combat tile woodland. Units with "Mountaineer" favor overland hill/mountain/volcano terrain and combat tile rock/mountain. Units with "Waterwalking" favor overland swamp/tundra/river terrain and combat tile swamp/tundra. Units with "Pathfinding" are counted as have both "Forester" and "Mountaineer". Tactician is mutually exclusive with Warlord. Additionally, teleporting units gain first strike and non-corporeal units gain negate first strike. Version 1.4.14 Spells: - Nagas now cost 1 upkeep (from 2) - Heroic Heart research cost is now 240 (from 440) - The 10 common-tier spell research costs sum up to exactly 2880 (prior to this version, sums were not uniform). Chaos was particularly adding up to a high number, benefiting most. - The common-tier spell research cost rankings shifted around while adding to exactly 2880 - Based on above two points, the average common-tier research cost is down by roughly 10% - Uncommon-tier, Rare-tier, and Very-rare tier spell research costs standardized so no realm benefits with avg research cost higher or lower than others. Regular cost and unit design with the expected +1hp -1resist swimmer racial traits Bug Fixes: - Survival Instinct was granting bonuses incorrectly, usually better than intended. Version 1.4.1 Unit and Summon Changes: - Four racial unique fighter's guild units boosted in effectiveness and cost, following the trend of armory-tier racial uniques.
PDF page 147 - Gnoll marauder: 120 cost (+30) 3 upk (+1) 8 melee (+1) 4 armor (-1) 3hp (+1) - High men knight: 120 cost (+20) 8 melee (+1) 6 resist (+1) - Nomad sipahi: 120 cost (+20) 3 thrown (+1) 5 range (+1) 5 armor (+1) - Beasmen Centaur: 100 cost (+10) upk 3 (+1) 6 resist (+1) 5 move (+1) - War Bears cost 65 (+10), 2 upkeep (+1) and 10hp per figure (+2 per figure). Increased lair and rampaging cost. - Killer Wasp cost 55 (-10), 1 upkeep (-1) and 30% to hit (-10%) Decreased lair and rampaging cost. - Hell Hounds cost 55 (+5) and have 4 firebreath (+1). Slightly increased lair and rampaging cost. Buildings: - Town Hall now grants 0.5 hammer per worker instead of +0.25 for farmers and workers. (this prevents the issue of switching workers to farmers with no reduction in hamer yield) Wizards: - How many spells are granted per book adjusted (1-3-4-5-6-7-8-10) to boost benefit of 1-4 books per realm. Used to start with 1-2-4 but is now 1-3-4 - Spellweaver is now a 1-pick retort and grants a 20% reduction in cost (from 33%) for non-summon non-item overland spells. It is no longer mutually exclusive with Archmage. - Resheph (Rjak) now gains specialist due to Spellweaver change. Spells: - Disintegrate no longer researchable, can still be cast by focus magic efreets. - Dissolution (cost 90) takes the place of disintegrate, a guaranteed 9 armor-piercing irrecoverable damage (equivalent to 30 strength spell) per figure before shields. This spell's extraordinary power almost always wipes out massively enchanted multi-figure units, thus acting as a counter against mega-buffing strategies. - Sanctify units become life-realm units - Blood Lust no longer grants the various immunities. Bloodlusted units can heal naturally. - Blood Lust can be cast in combat for 25 cost. - Apotheosis removes no healing and undead from enchanted units - Land Linking renamed to Land Link, costs 10 more, now also grants +1 resistance to any unit, and can be cast in combat (at 20% cost, or 12 cost) - Haste can be cast overland for 200 cost and 8 upkeep. The doubled movement applies only to combat. - Banish costs 40 (+5) and has a resistance modifier of -5 (-1) - Creature binding costs 55 (+5) and has a resistance modifier of -5 (-1) Visual: - Unit debuffs from Drought and Eternal Night enchantments now come with ability icons and explanations, helping player understand the details behind these debuffs. Version 1.4.0 Unit and Summon Changes: - Zombies have 20+ higher casting/lair cost, but move 2 (+1) and attack 5 (+1) - Wraiths lose guaranteed raise undead (redundant with vampire), cost 250 (50 less) - Gorgons cost 320 (40 less) lose supernatural trait - Nightblades gain stealth, +1 move, +30 cost - Ballista and Catapult have 1 less range attack. - All priest units and draconian saint cost 20 more to produce (120 and 140, respectively) - Shamans, Monks, Priests and Saints do not count as trespassers when you have a wizard's pact. - Rampaging monster cost of zombies, fire elemental, water elemental, boars lowered while Phantom Beast, and Ethereal Knight was increased. Rampage-only Lord Units - Lesser Chaos/Gaia/Aether Lords will begin showing up as rampaging monsters if game goes for too long. The greater lords show up later in game after lesser lords with greater stats, spellcasting abilities and realm traits. Spell Changes: - Dark Rituals changed from 17+50% religion power to 8+100% religion power. AI Changes: - Shifted building preferences to fit the balancing changes of Warlord Mod, with added emphasis later on towards Armorer's Guild and Fantastic Stable. - More likely to build granary Buildings: - Miner's Guild now costs 200 (-40) to build. Bugs Fixed: - gold display tag for gold gain from alchemist's guild with philosopher's stone - research display tag for nature's witness - description display of High Men, Nomad, Orc, and Trolling falling off the screen - Drought was not correctly reducing new units' attack and defense Other:
PDF page 148 - Updated to support 1.4 Caster of Magic version - Good/Bad Moon event religious power effect weakened to +50% and -33%. - First turn one could obtain 'rare' or 'very rare' spell in treasure adjusted to year 6 and 11 in fair difficulty, reduced by difficulty (12 turns per difficulty increase after fair). Graphic Changes: - Visually, Dragon Turtle now shows the lightning breath (instead of fire breath) - Sprite update for Cloud Giant Version 1.3.8 Unit and Summon Changes: -Fire Elemental, Earth Elemental, Phantom Beast, Phantom Warrior upkeep reduced by 1 -Ghost Ship loses transport, gains windwalking Spell Changes: - Evil Presence (+20 cost) – Not only does it prevent units from being recruited with experience or magic weapons, but now also prevents positive recruitment effects introduced by warlord mod, such as effects from Survival Instinct, free disciplines/resist elements, doom mastery and chaos embrace, etc - Drought (+50 cost / +1 upk) – Now also causes newly recruited units to be malnourished, are debuffed with 1 less melee and 2 less armor. - Eternal Night (+200 cost / +9 upk) – Now also causes newly recruited range units to be trained less well in ranged combat, reducing permanently range attacks by 2 permanently while Eternal Night is in play. Eternal Night also given 2 unrest instead of 1. - Spell of Mastery now costs 9,000 with research cost 330,000. Graphic Changes: - Summon event graphic for 'Demon' and 'Vampire' updated - Minor correction of summon event graphic of ‘Coatl” - Main menu now displays name of mod. AI Changes: - NEW: Overland base skill bonus: difficulties 100-100-100-110-120-130-140-150 - Overland spell cost reduction moderated on higher difficulties: 100-95-90-80-70-66-60-60 (see above) - Fair difficulty now also give +10% power and research bonus to AI Version 1.3.7 Unit and Summon Changes: - Klackon Mantis now costs 100 (from 90) - Klackon Stag Beetle now has +2 melee attack (17 base attack) - Doom bat now costs 300 (from 320) - Unicorns gain first strike - Vampire now loses life steal but gains create undead - Ghoul costs 80 (from 88) - previous version nerf damaged early-game death too much. - Disciples, Magisters, and Druids have 6 shots (From 4) - Barbarian Longship gain 2 melee but lose half the ammo. - The generic fire galley has +1 ranged but -4 ammo – intended to be more melee oriented. - Settler HP reduced to 14hp for lizardmen/beastmen, 18hp for dwarves, 22hp for trolls. Hero and Item Changes: - Costs have been modified to be lower for weakest effects but become more incremental, to balance against the 'complexity' cost adjustment formula that encourages fewer traits for cost effectiveness. This should decrease the cost of effects such as +1-2 attack/armor/hp/etc. - Attack 50-100-150-250-400-650 - Armor: 75-150-225-375 (Armor caps at +4 for items with just +2 with create item). - Movement: 250-500-1000 - Resistance: 100-200-300-400-500-600 - Spell Skill: 75-150-225-375 - Spell Save: 200-400-800-1600 - Health: 75-150-300 - Item flaming ability cost change to 200 - Item destruction ability cost change to 400 - Item wraithform ability cost change to 250 and nolonger and can add with enchant item - Item bless ability cost change to 150 - Item ability lionheart rename to mystic power, cost increase to 2000 and nolonger need life book - Item water walking ability cost change to 75 - Item pathfinding ability cost change to 100 - Item resist element ability cost change to 150 - Item regeneration ability cost change to 1000 - Item guardian wind ability cost change to 150 - Item teleporting ability cost change to 900 - Item amplifier ability cost change to 300 All heroes now start with base 40% to hit as a minimum. Ranged attack ratings lowered to compensate by approximately 20%. Melee stats
PDF page 149 generally unchanged. Starting Spells and Books: - Starting and guaranteed common and uncommon tier default spell choices changed to punish players less when choosing default options. - Books System changed further (see 'Book System' for more detail). To summarize: • Guaranteed rares and very rares eliminated • Book-based discounts changed from 8% research / 5% spell per book starting book #9 to 5% research (starting book #6) and 3% (starting book #7) • Books 9 and 10 grant an additional starting common spell. • The minor changes to available # of spells (to be made more symmetrical) and the 1 available spell per realms without books is still part of mod. AI Changes: - Enemy AI : algorithm to reroll enemy AI researchable spells when not satisfying certain conditions changed and now takes into consideration changed spells in Warlord Mod. - Enemy AI has slightly modified production priority of units for better prioritization (Beastmen Chironean Guard fixed, AI should now recruit it) - AI would not pick some races or mono-sorcery with cult leader - AI would never pick warlord with mono-death and conjurer with mono-life. - Difficulty modifier changes around casking skill and gold: *overland skill: 100-95-90-80-70-65-55-50 (smaller bonus starting normal difficulty) *Upkeep cost: 100-95-90-80-75-75-75-60 (smaller bonus starting normal difficulty) *Gold Income: 100-100-110-125-150-175-200-210 (larger bonus starting fair difficulty) *Starting Gold: 0-120-140-200-350-500-700-900 (smaller bonus starting advanced difficulty) Spell Changes: - Tree of Knowledge costs 100 less to cast (500 → 400) - Focus Magic (uncommon-tier in mod) can be cast in combat. However, the mana capacity boost does not translate to current unit mana, preventing abusable strategies. - Counter Magic costs 10 less, research cost down to 1600, but strength of spell down by 10 points. - Phantom Beast research cost is now 2140 - Nature's Witness now costs 50 (from 40), was too strong - Nature's Embrace loses the 20 population growth bonus. Enchantment was strong enough without it. - Herb Mastery has two added effects: it increases overall population growth of cities by +33% while halving pop reducing effects, a soft counter to Death realm. Herb mastery also has a new spell picture. - Enlightment has 20 higher upkeep cost. - Crack's Call redesigned. Costs 30. It does 4 separate rolls of 25% chance to deal 5 damage and 1 separate roll to bury unit at 5% * unit armor chance (100% chance for 20 armor unit) In Game Documentation: - Typos removed from building descriptions -Typos removed from race descriptions -Typos removed from spell descriptions. - outdated descriptions in spellbook interface corrected Bugs: - Chaos Embrace Global Spell was resetting firebreath units to firebreath 4 (from higher numbers).
